services.desc: Our Most Popular Tour! Our Tikis Boat Cruise is perfect for all types of occasions, from birthdays and bachelorette parties to corporate events and family gatherings. With our customizable route, you can even request specific destinations to visit on your tour. At the end of your journey, you'll return to the dock with unforgettable memories and stunning photos to share with your loved ones. Book your Tikis Boat Cruise today and experience Bay St. Louis in a way you never thought possible. Cruise Type: BYOB Public Cruise 90 minutes Boat Capacity: 2-6 guests

blurb: Guests join a tiki party on a boat cruising Bay St Louis with island-themed music and drinks. Cruises include morning, half-day, and sunset options with customizable routes and dolphin sightings. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests plus crew and is suitable for parties and events.
